pull_request.title: Calorimeter: add material-preserving DD4hep service routing
pull_request.head: codex/lar-routing-dd4hep
pull_request.body:
Adds an isolated DD4hep version of the old/new LAr service routing proposed in #142. The user selected the existing 20 mm OD / 18 mm ID steel/N₂ pipe materials. Undefined cables and 100 mm jackets remain explicitly unmaterialised envelopes.

Both routes share endpoints and the same analytic 4968.343720697463 mm path. Circular CutTube chords with shared miter planes approximate bends; a small common radius correction preserves both constituent volumes at fixed recipes and densities. The default 32 routes are representative, not a complete cooling circuit. Governing prototype input: `docs/design/inputs/DES-032-routing-dd4hep.md` (DES-032/DES-033; TASK-LAR-ROUTING-DD4HEP). Production geometry is unchanged.

Validation at clean native source `8210fbcca843d385103dcc14367d0587f9d85ba3`:

- Old/new: 2752 material pieces, zero overlaps at 10 nm, 5376 joint material points and 2688 boundary crossings each. Native recipes, volumes/masses and transforms checked. Each retains 74.401406957 kg steel and 0.809145269 kg N₂ across 32 routes.
- Finer 2.5° construction: 5184 pieces, zero overlaps and 10240 joint probes. Approximation sagitta is separate from overlap tolerance; no directional material-budget convergence claim.
- Six saved serial Geant4 geantino events pass conversion, observed-primary and actual passive wall/core/miter step audits. JSONL is the event evidence; empty passive ROOT outputs are diagnostics.
- Unchanged native ECAL occupancy: 54016 samples/variant witness existing cooling-pipe continuation and closed vessel contacts. `fit_accepted=false`; no combined overlay, 400 mm shift or response claim.
- 16 routing controls passed; author reported all 55 LAr controls passed. Separate final PhysVal, SysArch and nonauthor SoftEng reviews at `f4c15efeb3e0c62bbe5611b53df56b57fb7bc199` found no actionable issues for this bounded scope. Report replay and independent material/ray-step arithmetic agreed; reviewers did not rerun native jobs.

Source/hash-bound compact results, environment and exact commands are in `docs/validation/lar-routing-dd4hep/`. Raw XML/ROOT/placement inventories, step JSONL and logs remain ignored. Node preflight fingerprint warning was reported; current DD4hep 1.38 / Geant4 11.4.3 / ROOT 6.40.04 and preinstalled nlohmann-json 3.12.0 were verified. No shared dependencies installed or changed.

Stacked on draft #142 (base `codex/lar-gap-hadron-options`) to keep proposal and implementation review separate. Paired work/role/tool records and six exact closed child-turn token observations are retained; the active coordinator turn is excluded, so usage coverage is incomplete. Draft only: sealed ports, proper daughter displacement, circuit/support/board interfaces and external integration remain open. No engineering acceptance or production adoption.

events.text:
**LAR-ROUTING-PhysVal — `b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01`**

The proposed conservation method is mathematically sound for a standalone **20 mm steel/N₂ pipe reference**, provided the miter and degeneracy guards below are enforced. It preserves constituent inventory between the illustrative old/new routes; it does not establish integrated routing feasibility.

**Independent analytic check**

Let \(R=400\) mm, radial shift \(d=293.7\) mm, and
\[
\theta=\cos^{-1}(1-d/(2R)),\qquad a=2R\sin\theta.
\]

For S-bend start \(s\), the upstream and downstream straight lengths sum to
\[
(s-3000)+(5880-s-a)=5880-3000-a.
\]
Thus translating the S-bend from 4170 to 3300 mm preserves the complete common-endpoint path.

I independently reproduce:

- \(\theta=50.7374452221^\circ\); S-bend axial advance \(619.4031885614\) mm.
- Total analytic route length **4968.343720697463 mm**.
- Steel volume **296561.7305355904 mm³**.
- N₂-core volume **1264289.482809622 mm³**.
- At the pinned densities: **2.325043967 kg steel + 0.025285790 kg N₂ per reference route**.

These agree with `docs/design/inputs/DES-032-routing-dd4hep.md`. Material provenance is explicit in `barrel_geometry.py:194–205`, `barrel_services.py` and `services.json`: retain the 7.84 g/cm³ Fe/Cr/Ni steel recipe and provisional 0.02 g/cm³ nitrogen core.

**Why the radius correction works**

For a full-azimuth CutTube whose end planes pass through its chord endpoints, local axial thickness is affine across the annular section. Its linear terms integrate to zero, so its volume is
\[
V=\pi(r_o^2-r_i^2)\ell.
\]

Consequently, applying the common scale
\[
f=\sqrt{L_{\rm analytic}/L_{\rm polyline}}
\]
to **both** radii preserves steel and core volumes separately, while keeping composition and density unchanged.

For subdivisions of at most 5°—11+11 S-bend chords and 18 rear-elbow chords—I obtain:

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---:|
| Polyline length | 4967.953085169159 mm |
| Radius scale | 1.000039314768365 |
| Adjusted outer radius | 10.0003931477 mm |
| Adjusted inner radius | 9.0003538329 mm |
| Maximum centreline sagitta | 0.3807113673 mm |

Independent annular quadrature reproduced the affine-cut volume exactly at reported precision. A shared-face ellipse test reproduced both neighbouring cylindrical surfaces to **2.84×10⁻¹⁴ mm²** squared-radius residual.

**Required construction guards**

- Require full \(2\pi\) azimuth for this simple volume formula.
- Use a shared global bisector plane at every join: adjacent pieces receive opposite outward normals. Identical radii then give matching elliptical faces.
- Transform normals into each proper local frame; enforce unit finite normals with the ROOT low/high sign convention. [ROOT CutTube specification]([external URL redacted; see source journal]).
- Reject zero-length, reversing or nearly singular joins.
- Check positive thickness over the entire outer disk. With local plane slopes \(q_0,q_1\), a sufficient exact condition is
  \[
  \ell>r_o\lVert q_1-q_0\rVert.
  \]
- Check non-neighbouring pieces and replicated routes for self-intersections; correct adjacent miters alone do not prevent these.

**Preservation limits and discriminating validation**

Mass conservation does **not** preserve exact toroidal shape or directional \(\int ds/X_0\). Intrinsic material \(X_0\) remains unchanged at fixed composition/density, but moving material changes individual ray budgets.

The **10 nm overlap tolerance applies to the constructed approximation**, not its agreement with a circular bend: the 5° sagitta is about 0.381 mm. Refinement to 2.5° and 1° gives approximately **0.09519 mm** and **0.01523 mm** sagitta. Keep the same analytic volume target during refinement and report directional/material convergence separately.

Useful native/G4 controls are:

- Read back actual CutTube dimensions, normals, transforms, material recipes, volumes and masses independently of exported expectations.
- Test old/new totals, all joins, wall/core disjointness, containment and seeded full overlaps.
- Probe both sides of miter planes, including near-wall/grazing rays, against independently calculated cylinder/plane intersections.
- In the serial transport smoke, save actual volume/material step lengths. Persisted primaries alone do not prove navigation through passive pipes.
- Keep old/new compacts separate. An overlay onto existing calorimeter services must expose duplicate material or occupied-space conflicts rather than silently replacing them.

The 100 mm utility jacket and cables remain **unmaterialised metadata**, with no invented wall/core mixture. Route replication is an illustrative multiplicity, not an engineered circuit bill.

No files changed or native runtime activated. Actual checks were independent arithmetic, resolution calculations, annular quadrature and shared-face geometry tests. Native construction, overlaps, Geant4 conversion/navigation and integrated fit remain unexecuted by this assignment.

`LAR-ROUTING-SysArch` — reviewed **b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01**; drawing/source reference **3fca74b70709345a9440b17cf23acb40aab1f945**.

The scope is defensible as a **standalone matched cooling-pipe experiment**. It cannot yet be described as valid integration with the calorimeter. [Implementation contract](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01/docs/design/inputs/DES-032-routing-dd4hep.md#L8-L74)

- The physical material is the existing **20 mm OD/18 mm ID steel pipe with provisional N2 core**. The 100 mm jacket and cables remain unmaterialised envelopes. Preserve that distinction in inventories, occupancy classifications and conclusions.
- Independently reproduced both routes’ analytic length: **4968.343720697462 mm**. Per route, steel/core volumes are **296561.7305355904 /1264289.482809622 mm³**, with masses **2325.0439674 /25.2857897 g**. Equality depends on retaining the common upstream endpoint and all straights. Replication counts/azimuths must be explicit; station counts do not define a complete cooling circuit.
- The common endpoint at \(|z|3000,\ R2735.3\) lies within existing N2 half-branches spanning \(|z|5–3905\). At matching azimuths, an overlay duplicates existing pipe/core occupancy: old route shares **3000–3905**, new route shares **3000–3300** before bending. This is a continuation/circuit-interface conflict, not additional independent services. [Existing branches](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01/tools/lar_calorimeter/barrel_services.py#L64-L69)
- Separate actual pipe contacts from envelope failures. The nominal bare 20 mm pipe clears the maximum H-ring radius by **22 mm** and board-corner radius by **9.6897 mm**. A 100 mm envelope can intersect these occupied bands. Neither conclusion substitutes for native swept-path checks.
- Closed vessel boundaries remain unavoidable interfaces. The old axial path crosses end bath **3910–4017.2**, cold endwall **4017.2–4021**, vacuum **4021–4070**, and warm endwall **4070–4100 mm**. The new analytic S-centreline reaches radial shell boundaries at approximately **3401.1484,3480.4190,3555.2176,3558.4413 mm**. These are probe seeds, not exact polyline contact locations. [Shell construction](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01/tools/lar_calorimeter/barrel_geometry.py#L282-L307)

Recommended bounded diagnostics: sample the unchanged native context independently at route centreline, steel-wall normal/binormal offsets, joins and boundary-adjacent points. Report bath displacement, duplicate N2 occupancy, closed structural boundaries and empty-envelope violations separately. Include both signs and actual route azimuths; label sampling resolution and coverage. Do not transport through a diagnostic overlay with unresolved overlaps.

The original factory already treats services inside baths as daughters with an exclusive displacement ledger. A standalone world-level route cannot acquire that ownership automatically. Material-preserving standalone results therefore establish the new component’s inventory, not a material-consistent combined detector. [Existing ownership](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/b0d54812e668714c14a3193e57ed4365f2fcbd01/prototypes/calorimeter/LArBarrel.cpp#L143-L165)

Actual checks: verified all eight supplied SHA-256 hashes; inspected pinned material, shell, support, factory and build inputs; independently recalculated lengths, constituent volumes/masses and analytic probe bounds. **No files changed, runtime activation, native checks, delegation or engineering acceptance.** The new route implementation/native results were not present in this reviewed source set.
